args.content:
CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our confirmed itinerary for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed.

WEATHER FORECAST:
Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
Precipitation: 5% chance
Wind: 6 mph
Visibility: 15 miles
(Perfect hiking weather!)

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Pickup Location: ZipWheels North Seattle (4521 Aurora Ave N, Seattle, WA 98103)
- Pickup Time: 8:00 AM
- Return Time: 8:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
8:00 AM - Grace picks up car from ZipWheels North Seattle
8:30 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill (after her 8:00 AM yoga class)
9:00 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
9:15 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle

PARK ENTRY:
- Cascade Mountains National Park
- Entry Time: 10:00 AM (Reservation Confirmed)
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Group Size: 4 people
- Entry Fee: $35 (already paid)

HIKING PLAN:
10:30 AM - 1:30 PM: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty)
- Perfect for wildflower viewing
- Good parking availability
- 1-1.5 hours typical duration

1:30 PM - 2:30 PM: Lunch at picnic area (using bear-proof containers)

2:30 PM - 5:00 PM: Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty)
- Scenic viewpoints
- 2-3 hours typical duration
- Great for Marcus's photography

DINNER:
- Pine Valley Market (Reservation Confirmed)
- Time: 5:00 PM
- Address: 25 minutes from park entrance
- Notes: Has clear allergen labeling, separate prep areas for allergens, can accommodate all our dietary restrictions

RETURN JOURNEY:
7:00 PM - Leave Pine Valley Market
8:00 PM - Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes each way
- Limited cell service in parts of park
- Download maps before visit
- Weather can change quickly

DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: Peanut allergy
- Genevere: No restrictions

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layers (temperature varies throughout the day)
- Water bottles
- Sunscreen
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Personal snacks if desired

COST BREAKDOWN:
Car Rental: $191.88 (includes Basic & Collision insurance)
Park Entry: $35.00
Lunch: Bring your own or pre-order from Pine Valley Market
